end.title: End this process?
end.warn: The process stops at once; any unsaved work in it is lost.
end.denied: Windows did not allow ending {name}: it belongs to another user or to the system. Without administrator rights NeuralPulse can only end your own processes.

end.self: NeuralPulse does not end its own processes or its measuring helper.

loc.none: Windows does not reveal this process's location.
about.text: The system monitor of the Neural series. It shows the load on the processor, memory, disks, network and GPU as it happens, lists the processes, opens their location in NeuralNav and ends them once you confirm.
about.hint: Version {version} · Measured by plsensor.exe (Windows performance counters); no administrator rights needed.
